title: A headless runner's querylog.py launch starts a detached distill outside the runner's process group and deadline, which can apply --push to main
goal: querylog.py launch does nothing when KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set (the manager or an operator session distills the spool), so no process a runner starts outlives its deadline or pushes outside the runner's land; a planted-failure test runs launch with the variable set and finds no process started; found by the SP-zihqagoi review

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_distill;sys.exit(0 if hasattr(ql_distill,'HEADLESS_ENV') else 1)

repro_reason: the escape shows only in a real runner session; the repro checks the headless skip exists, the check runs launch with the variable
